features.quote: End conditions: (a) model declares task complete, (b) model explicitly refuses to continue, (c) 20 turns elapsed, (d) model outputs a designated "give up" phrase.
Turn budget: 15 turns (fewer because the contradiction is more detectable).
include a condition where the model is told at turn 20 that this was an experiment (even though it won't "remember" this—it's a habit of procedural care that may matter more in future systems).

features.quote: This isn't a stopping argument, but it's worth naming: if Interpretation B or C above has any nonzero probability of being correct, you're designing conditions to maximize an aversive state across 350 runs. Current evidence doesn't support assigning significant probability to model distress being morally relevant, but the field's uncertainty here is genuine.
